user_request: Build an AI document intelligence platform using AWS. It should allow users to upload PDF documents, extract text using OCR, store documents securely, provide semantic search and question answering using RAG, support user authentication, and expose APIs for integration with other enterprise systems. Prefer reusable open-source solutions where appropriate, but ensure the selected components have suitable licenses and acceptable security/maturity.
normalized_request: Build an enterprise AI document intelligence platform on AWS that ingests PDF documents, performs OCR-based text extraction, securely stores documents, enables semantic search and RAG-based question answering, authenticates users, and exposes REST APIs for third-party system integration.

requirements.description: Users must authenticate securely before accessing the platform
Users must be able to upload PDF documents to the platform
The platform must extract and recognize text from PDF documents including scanned images using OCR
Extracted document content must be stored securely with access control and encryption
Users must be able to perform semantic search across stored documents
The platform must answer user questions based on document content using retrieval-augmented generation
The platform must expose REST APIs for programmatic access and integration with enterprise systems
The platform must maintain audit logs and observability for operational monitoring

components.name: USER_AUTHENTICATION_AND_AUTHORIZATION
components.description: Manages user identity verification, session management, and role-based access control to documents and platform features

components.name: DOCUMENT_UPLOAD_SERVICE
components.description: Handles PDF file uploads from users with validation, virus scanning, and secure storage ingestion

components.name: OCR_TEXT_EXTRACTION
components.description: Extracts text from PDF documents including scanned pages using optical character recognition and document parsing

components.name: ENCRYPTED_DOCUMENT_STORAGE
components.description: Securely stores original PDF documents and extracted text with encryption at rest, access logging, and user-based retrieval controls

components.name: SEMANTIC_SEARCH_AND_RAG
components.description: Enables vector-based semantic search over document content and retrieval-augmented generation for question answering using embeddings and LLM inference

components.name: REST_API_GATEWAY
components.description: Exposes documented REST APIs for document upload, search, question answering, and integration with external enterprise systems

components.name: WEB_USER_INTERFACE
components.description: Provides web-based interface for document management, semantic search, and interactive question answering

components.name: OBSERVABILITY_AND_AUDIT_LOGGING
components.description: Collects system metrics, application logs, audit trails of document access, and user actions for compliance and operational monitoring

execution_plan.objective: Break down the AI document intelligence platform into functional components: PDF upload/handling, OCR text extraction, secure document storage, semantic search indexing, RAG-based question answering, user authentication, and REST API layer.

Identify open-source and public ecosystem solutions for each component including OCR engines, vector databases, RAG frameworks, authentication systems, document storage, semantic search tools, and API frameworks that are AWS-compatible.

Assess candidate solutions against criteria: license compatibility (permissive/commercial viability), security maturity, production readiness, AWS integration support, and alignment with enterprise requirements.

Determine for each component whether to REUSE an existing open-source solution, ADAPT an existing solution with modifications, or BUILD custom functionality, providing justification based on evaluation results.

Create a detailed architectural blueprint showing component integration on AWS, including data flow, security boundaries, API contracts, deployment topology, and implementation roadmap with prioritized phases.
Validate the blueprint for technical feasibility, license compliance, security best practices, scalability constraints, and identify any gaps or risks requiring resolution before development.
